package api

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
)

// agentDetector identifies a coding agent that may be driving gh.
type agentDetector struct {
	// name is the identifier reported in the User-Agent header.
	name string
	// detect reports whether this agent appears to be driving gh.
	detect func() bool
}

// agentDetectors are evaluated in order and the first match wins, so they are
// ordered by how much confidence we have in each signal:
//
//  1. A generic agent declaration beats everything, as it is set by a process
//     that explicitly claims to be an agent.
//  2. Agent specific markers, which are only set by that agent.
//  3. Weak signals, which are present outside of an agentic session as well:
//     Replit's marker is set in any Replit environment, and Goose's marker only
//     tells us that Goose is configured as a model provider.
var agentDetectors = []agentDetector{
	// Generic declaration that some agent is driving the CLI.
	{name: "agent", detect: agentEnvSet("AGENT")},

	// Agent specific markers.
	{name: "claude-code", detect: agentEnvSet("CLAUDECODE", "CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT")},
	{name: "copilot-cli", detect: agentEnvSet("COPILOT_CLI_SESSION_ID", "GH_COPILOT_CLI")},
	{name: "codex", detect: agentEnvSet("CODEX_SANDBOX")},
	{name: "gemini-cli", detect: agentEnvSet("GEMINI_CLI")},
	{name: "antigravity", detect: agentEnvSet("ANTIGRAVITY_AGENT", "ANTIGRAVITY")},
	{name: "augment-cli", detect: agentEnvSet("AUGMENT_CLI", "AUGGIE_SESSION_ID")},
	{name: "cowork", detect: agentEnvSet("COWORK_SESSION_ID", "COWORK")},
	{name: "cursor-cli", detect: agentEnvSet("CURSOR_AGENT")},
	{name: "cursor", detect: agentEnvSet("CURSOR_TRACE_ID")},
	{name: "kiro", detect: agentEnvEquals("TERM_PROGRAM", "kiro")},
	{name: "pi", detect: agentEnvPathSegment(".pi", "PI_CONFIG_DIR", "PI_HOME", "PATH")},

	// Weak signals, which must never win over a stronger match above.
	{name: "replit", detect: agentEnvSet("REPL_ID")},
	{name: "goose", detect: agentEnvSet("GOOSE_PROVIDER")},
}

// detectAgent returns the name of the coding agent driving gh, or an empty
// string when no agent could be detected.
func detectAgent() string {
	for _, d := range agentDetectors {
		if d.detect() {
			return d.name
		}
	}
	return ""
}

// agentEnvSet matches when any of the given environment variables is set to a
// non-empty value.
func agentEnvSet(names ...string) func() bool {
	return func() bool {
		for _, name := range names {
			if os.Getenv(name) != "" {
				return true
			}
		}
		return false
	}
}

// agentEnvEquals matches when the given environment variable is exactly value.
func agentEnvEquals(name, value string) func() bool {
	return func() bool {
		return os.Getenv(name) == value
	}
}

// agentEnvPathSegment matches when any of the given environment variables
// contains segment as a complete path segment.
func agentEnvPathSegment(segment string, names ...string) func() bool {
	return func() bool {
		for _, name := range names {
			if agentHasPathSegment(os.Getenv(name), segment) {
				return true
			}
		}
		return false
	}
}

// agentHasPathSegment reports whether value contains segment as a complete path
// segment, accepting either Unix or Windows separators. Incidental occurrences
// such as "/home/user/.pip" or "/opt/happi/bin" do not match.
func agentHasPathSegment(value, segment string) bool {
	if value == "" || segment == "" {
		return false
	}

	isSeparator := func(r rune) bool {
		return r == '/' || r == '\\'
	}

	for _, part := range strings.FieldsFunc(value, isSeparator) {
		if part == segment {
			return true
		}
	}

	return false
}

// Package agent detects third-party coding agents that drive the gh CLI so
// that they can be identified in the User-Agent header.
package agent

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

// Agent names reported in the gh User-Agent header.
const (
	AgentAntigravity = "Antigravity"
	AgentAugmentCLI  = "Augment CLI"
	AgentClaudeCode  = "Claude Code"
	AgentCowork      = "Cowork"
	AgentCursor      = "Cursor"
	AgentCursorCLI   = "Cursor CLI"
	AgentGoose       = "Goose"
	AgentKiro        = "Kiro"
	AgentPi          = "Pi"
	AgentReplit      = "Replit"
)

// piConfigDir is the configuration directory Pi adds to paths it exports.
const piConfigDir = ".pi"

// Detect returns the name of the coding agent driving the CLI, or an empty
// string when no agent could be identified.
func Detect() string {
	return detect(os.Getenv)
}

// detect implements Detect with an injectable environment lookup so that the
// detection rules can be exercised in isolation.
//
// The checks are ordered by confidence: a generic agent declaration wins over
// everything, followed by agent specific markers. Replit and Goose markers are
// the weakest signals and are only consulted last.
func detect(getenv func(string) string) string {
	// Highest confidence: the environment explicitly declares that an agent is
	// driving the CLI.
	if v := strings.TrimSpace(getenv("AGENT")); v != "" {
		return v
	}

	// Agent specific markers.
	switch {
	case getenv("ANTIGRAVITY") != "" || strings.EqualFold(getenv("TERM_PROGRAM"), "antigravity"):
		return AgentAntigravity
	case getenv("AUGMENT_CLI") != "" || getenv("AUGGIE_SESSION_ID") != "":
		return AgentAugmentCLI
	case getenv("CLAUDECODE") != "" || getenv("CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT") != "":
		return AgentClaudeCode
	case getenv("COWORK") != "" || getenv("COWORK_SESSION_ID") != "":
		return AgentCowork
	case getenv("CURSOR_AGENT") != "":
		return AgentCursorCLI
	case getenv("CURSOR_TRACE_ID") != "":
		return AgentCursor
	case getenv("TERM_PROGRAM") == "kiro":
		// Kiro sets the terminal program name exactly; avoid substring matches.
		return AgentKiro
	case hasPathSegment(getenv("PI_HOME"), piConfigDir) || hasPathSegment(getenv("PATH"), piConfigDir):
		return AgentPi
	}

	// REPL_ID is present in any Replit environment, not just agent driven
	// sessions, so it only identifies Replit when nothing stronger matched.
	if getenv("REPL_ID") != "" {
		return AgentReplit
	}

	// GOOSE_PROVIDER only tells us that Goose is configured as a model
	// provider, so any other match takes precedence over it.
	if getenv("GOOSE_PROVIDER") != "" {
		return AgentGoose
	}

	return ""
}

// hasPathSegment reports whether any path in p contains segment as a complete
// path segment, considering both Unix and Windows separators.
func hasPathSegment(p, segment string) bool {
	if p == "" || segment == "" {
		return false
	}
	for _, entry := range filepath.SplitList(p) {
		segments := strings.FieldsFunc(entry, func(r rune) bool {
			return r == '/' || r == '\\'
		})
		for _, s := range segments {
			if s == segment {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}
